tools.name: goteamup_get_authenticated_application
tools.description: Show the API application this token belongs to and the businesses (providers) it can reach, with their numeric ids — a cheap way to confirm the token works and to find the value for GOTEAMUP_PROVIDER_ID. TeamUp: GET /auth/application.

tools.name: goteamup_list_customers
tools.description: Search and list the business's customers (members and leads). Filter by free text (email and name), CRM status, active memberships, age or family. Deferred fields such as field_values, credit_balance or sms_account can be added with expand. TeamUp: GET /customers.

tools.name: goteamup_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: name, email, family role, lead flag, CRM status, created date. Use expand for deferred fields, e.g. field_values,credit_balance,staff_assignments. TeamUp: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_events
tools.description: List scheduled sessions — classes and appointments — with start/end time, status, capacity, attending and waitlist counts, instructors, venue and offering type. Filter by time window, instructor, venue, offering type, status or occupancy. TeamUp: GET /events.

tools.name: goteamup_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one class or appointment by id, including capacity, attending/waiting counts, registration open/close and late-cancel deadlines. TeamUp: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_attendances
tools.description: List bookings: who is registered for, attended, no-showed or late-cancelled which event, and with which customer membership. Filter by customer, event, venue, offering type, status or event start window. Use expand=customer,event for names. TeamUp: GET /attendances.

tools.name: goteamup_list_customer_memberships
tools.description: List memberships held by customers — status (active, hold, complete, cancelled), start/expiration/renewal dates, billed price, active hold. Filter by customer, membership plan, type, status, dates or holds. TeamUp: GET /customer_memberships.

tools.name: goteamup_get_customer_membership
tools.description: Fetch one customer membership by id. Use expand=usage_summary,next_billing_date,shared_with for usage, next bill and sharing. TeamUp: GET /customer_memberships/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_memberships
tools.description: List the membership products the business sells — packs, recurring and prepaid plans — with price, duration, allotment, active member count and visibility. TeamUp: GET /memberships.

tools.name: goteamup_list_offering_types
tools.description: List offering types — the kinds of classes, appointments and courses the business runs — with schedule type, drop-in price, age limits, visibility and status. TeamUp: GET /offering_types.

tools.name: goteamup_list_instructors
tools.description: List the business's instructors (coaches, trainers) with name, bio and linked staff id. TeamUp: GET /instructors.

tools.name: goteamup_list_venues
tools.description: List the business's venues (physical locations and online venues) with address, timezone and rooms. TeamUp: GET /venues.

tools.name: goteamup_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status (open, paid, failed, voided, upcoming, …), due date, amount due, payer and receipt URL. Filter by status or a customer membership. TeamUp: GET /invoices.

tools.name: goteamup_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id. Use expand=line_items,charges,discounts,taxes,applied_credits for the breakdown. TeamUp: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_crm_interactions
tools.description: List logged CRM interactions (calls, emails, meetings, contacted) with notes and who logged them, optionally for one customer. Requires a super_admin-level token. TeamUp: GET /crm/interactions.

tools.name: goteamup_create_customer
tools.description: Add a new customer to the business as staff. By default TeamUp emails them an invitation to claim the profile; set send_invitation_email=false to add them silently. TeamUp: POST /customers.

tools.name: goteamup_register_customer_for_event
tools.description: Register a customer for a class or appointment, optionally using a specific customer membership, or comped (free). Returns the attendance id. Undo with goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/register.

tools.name: goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event
tools.description: Cancel a customer's booking for a class or appointment. is_late_cancel=true records it as a LATE cancel, which can trigger the business's penalty rules — leave it unset unless asked. The response says whether it counted as late. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/unregister.

tools.name: goteamup_confirm_attendance
tools.description: Confirm that a customer attended an event (check them in). Returns the updated attendance. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/confirm_attendance.

tools.name: goteamup_log_crm_interaction
tools.description: Record a call, email, meeting or contact with a customer or lead, with an optional note and call outcome. Requires a super_admin-level token. TeamUp: POST /crm/interactions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "goteamup_create_customer" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: goteamup_list_customers, goteamup_get_customer, goteamup_list_invoices, goteamup_list_crm_interactions, goteamup_confirm_attendance · Private data: goteamup_get_authenticated_application, goteamup_list_crm_interactions, goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event, goteamup_log_crm_interaction · Public sink: goteamup_list_customers, goteamup_get_customer, goteamup_create_customer, goteamup_register_customer_for_event, goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event, goteamup_confirm_attendance, goteamup_log_crm_interaction · Destructive: goteamup_list_offering_types.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: goteamup_list_customers, goteamup_get_customer, goteamup_list_invoices, goteamup_list_crm_interactions, goteamup_confirm_attendance · Private data: goteamup_get_authenticated_application, goteamup_list_crm_interactions, goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event, goteamup_log_crm_interaction · Public sink: goteamup_list_customers, goteamup_get_customer, goteamup_create_customer, goteamup_register_customer_for_event, goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event, goteamup_confirm_attendance, goteamup_log_crm_interaction · Destructive: goteamup_list_offering_types

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
